title: Understudy plugin manifest v1 (PLG-1, extended by CONNECTIONS)
description: plugin.yaml for a source, skill, tool or mcp plugin. The pattern (id, version, kind, permissions, entry) follows the MIT Clicky Hermes plugin manifest and is re-implemented here. A source plugin is read-only and local-only: permissions is exactly [read], egress is local_only, and a plugin that needs the network or a token (the Graph sources) must be off by default and name the environment flag that turns it on. The loader checks, beyond this schema, that the entry imports, is a Source subclass whose plugin_id equals id, and that schema names a registered item schema (understudy_engine.plugins.schemas). CONNECTIONS adds kind mcp (a preset for an MCP server the worker connects with one click: stdio or streamable HTTP, read-only by default, classes decided by our own per-tool table) and gives kind tool its meaning (an in-process typed tool; entry is module:callable). Both carry a `connection` block validated by connection.schema.json and by understudy_engine.connections.manifest. A kind mcp manifest has no entry, because nothing of ours is imported: the server is a separate process started only after the worker's click and consent.

permissions.description: Read only. A plugin never writes to the source it reads; a write a connected tool offers is decided per call, by a person, in the approval queue.

egress.description: local_only: raw items never leave the machine; only digests pass the egress guard (PRV-1). app_only (kind mcp or tool only): the connected server's process talks to the hosts named in connection.real.hosts and to nothing else; that traffic is outside our frame egress guard.

schema.description: Item schema id, for example calendar_event.v1. Required for kind source.

entry.description: module.path:ClassName for a source (a Source subclass), module.path:function for a tool. Absent for kind mcp.

network.description: True when the plugin may call a remote API. Then default_enabled must be false and enable_flag is required.

enable_flag.description: Environment variable that must be 1 for the plugin to load.

connection.description: Kind mcp, kind tool, or a source preset: validated by connection.schema.json.
